reasoning: The question asks whether Goryachkina's Elo rating on 2025-11-02 will be at least 1% higher than on 2025-10-26. From the FIDE profile data (snippet 1), her standard rating in 2025-Oct was 2541 and in 2025-Nov was 2540. A 1% increase from 2541 would require a rating of at least 2566.41. However, the data shows her rating actually decreased slightly from October to November (2541 to 2540). The question asks about specific dates within these months (Oct 26 and Nov 2), but monthly FIDE ratings are published once per month, not on specific dates. The evidence suggests ratings are reported at month-end. Given that her November rating (2540) is lower than her October rating (2541), and a 1% increase would require approximately 25+ rating points gain, this appears unlikely based on the historical pattern shown. Her ratings have been relatively stable in the 2540-2548 range during 2025, with no dramatic swings.
